title: High latency on a service
steps: metrics_query on prometheus/datadog to confirm the symptom (p50/p95/p99) and when it started
k8s_get the service's pods to rule out restarts, pending pods, or a shortage of healthy replicas
metrics_query for CPU/memory/connection saturation of the service and its direct dependencies
Check (cloud_read or a read-only shell command) whether a deploy or config change happened in the relevant window
Tell apart the service itself from a downstream dependency (DB, cache, external service) before proposing an action
Propose the safest mitigation first (e.g. rollback or scale out) before any structural change
After mitigating, metrics_query again to confirm latency is back in its normal range
